name: MajlisAlpha UAE Peer Benchmark Matrix
purpose: Give analysts a source-first framework for comparing UAE issuers by sector, metric quality, risk, and valuation sensitivity.
rankPolicy: Do not publish a peer rank unless the metric, period, official source URL, and analyst reason are recorded together.

coreQuestions: Which bank is better positioned if deposits stay expensive?
Which bank has the cleanest asset-quality signal?
Which bank can protect payout while funding growth?
Which developer has more durable presales and backlog?
Which company converts launches into free cash flow faster?
Which balance sheet can handle a slower property cycle?
Which dividend stream has stronger visibility?
Which cash-flow profile is more resilient to macro changes?
Which issuer has clearer capex and regulated-return language?
Which company has the cleanest explainability?
Which business has the most repeatable cash generation?
Which risk is most likely to be missed by headline screens?

matrixGate.readyRule: A peer comparison is ready only when every ranked claim has a cited reason and a reviewer can trace it back to source text.
